Grab the mic. Or grab a seat. Either way, you're in for it. 🎤✨ Beah Hazard hosts a night of karaoke chaos meets drop-dead drag in the Lounge — and honey, it's a full sensory experience. Belt your heart out on the anthem you've been saving for a night like this, then watch the queens turn around and serve a performance that puts your rendition to shame (lovingly). Every note welcome. Every shade welcome. Every body welcome. This is the kind of Wednesday that makes the rest of the week feel slow by comparison. Free entry means zero excuses — bring your friends, bring your nerves, bring your best key change. The Lounge is about to get loud. 🔥

🔞 21+

Picture it: mic in hand, lights low, and a room that's half karaoke bar, half drag stage — all chaos, all night. 💿🎶 Beah Hazard hosts the Lounge for a Wednesday that hits every register — the screech of a high note you weren't ready for, the gasp when a queen turns a lipsync into a moment, the roar when your table finally gets called up. It smells like spilled drinks and confidence. It sounds like your favorite song getting absolutely wrecked (in the best way) right before a queen shows you how it's really done. It feels like nobody's watching and everybody's watching, all at once. This is the vibe you didn't know your Wednesday needed. ✨

This one's for the shower singers, the car-karaoke legends, and everyone who's never touched a mic in their life. 🎤💗 Beah Hazard hosts a Wednesday in the Lounge built by queens, for everyone — every note welcome, every shade welcome, every body welcome. No judgment if you're off-key. No judgment if you're just here to watch the queens do it better. This is a room where you show up exactly as you are and leave a little more yourself than when you walked in. Bring your people, bring your song pick, bring your whole chest. Pasco's Latinx community and beyond — this stage is yours tonight. 💫

Here's the rundown 📋: Beah Hazard hosts Drag Queen Karaoke in the Lounge, and it's exactly the chaos and glam that name promises. Doors are free. Wednesday night. 7PM sharp. Sing a song, watch a queen serve, repeat as needed. No cover means no reason to sit this one out — grab your friends, pick your karaoke moment, and let the queens handle the rest. This happens every other Wednesday, so mark it and make it a habit. The Lounge fills up fast when the mic's involved, so get there early and claim your spot. 🎟️
